en: Heisenberg - Oh, Princess Iyolin. I heard you had a hard time in Bifrost recently.
Iyolin - Thanks to GS here, we came back safely. More importantly, I hear Imperial raiders have been appearing...

Erich - Allow me to explain. As you know, after the Empire built a fortress between our country and Pandragon, it often sent raiders to attack villages or spy on us. But once we tightened the fortress watch, the raids fell off sharply. Then, a few days ago, our patrol ran into an Imperial raiding force larger than any we had seen, and all of Astania is in an uproar. Most of the Templars are posted on the border, so only a few small patrols are searching for them.
Heisenberg - That is why we hope your forces, Princess, can wipe them out.
Iyolin - Lord Draupnir also thinks this Imperial move is no ordinary raid. He suspects their target is the Temple of the Sun.
Heisenberg - Now that you mention it, that is where our patrol found them. In any case, I will send some guards with you. We would be grateful if you could deal with this on our behalf.
